held.claim: Two returnees from Dubai, Jamal Hossain and his friend Sohel, who landed at Shahjalal airport at about 1.30 am on 4 November 2026 and set off for Kanchan in a private car driven by a driver they knew, were robbed at gunpoint at about 3 am in the Shamu Market area of the Purbachal 300-feet road of 18 bhori of gold jewellery, five phones, a laptop and a tab worth about Tk 46 lakh, by their account; the driver helped another car block theirs, and police arrested him, his brother and another man and recovered 8.5 bhori of gold (fits 'On the road from the airport').
held.quote: ভুক্তভোগী দুবাইপ্রবাসী জামাল হোসেন বলেন, মঙ্গলবার দিবাগত রাত দেড়টার দিকে তিনি ও তাঁর বন্ধু সোহেল দুবাই থেকে ঢাকার হজরত শাহজালাল আন্তর্জাতিক বিমানবন্দরে পৌঁছান।
